'''Sedrellium''' was a rare and expensive metal alloy that was produced by the [[Andoan mineral-fish]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used sedrellium to reinforce the hulls of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
